name: HerculesKabuterimon
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.
